title: Handling PDN connectivity request for UE configured for dual priority

entities.name: PDN connectivity request procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDN connectivity initiated by UE, handling dual priority configuration scenarios.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity establishment.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to reject PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: Low priority indicator
entities.description: IE indicating whether MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority or not.

entities.name: APN
entities.description: Access Point Name identifying the PDN gateway.

entities.name: PDN type
entities.description: Type of PDN connection (e.g., IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6).

entities.name: Existing PDN connection with low priority indicator
entities.description: Condition where PDN connection exists with low priority indicator set to MS configured for NAS signalling low priority.

entities.name: New request with non-low priority indicator
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request PDN connection with same APN but low priority indicator set to MS not configured for NAS signalling low priority.

entities.name: Inform upper layers of rejection
entities.description: Behavior where UE informs upper layers when PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT is received with cause #55.

entities.name: Deactivate existing PDN connection
entities.description: Behavior where UE deactivates existing PDN connection before sending new PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.

relations.description: PDN connectivity request procedure involves sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains low priority indicator IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains APN IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains PDN type IE.
Procedure execution is guarded by condition of existing PDN connection with low priority indicator.
Procedure execution is guarded by condition of new request with non-low priority indicator.
Receipt of PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT with cause #55 establishes behavior to inform upper layers.
Deactivation of existing PDN connection establishes sending of new PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.
